stories.h: Experimental compound burns fat without sacrificing muscle
stories.t: Researchers at UC Berkeley have identified a compound that could transform weight-loss treatment by helping the body burn more energy instead of suppressing appetite like Ozempic and Wegovy.

stories.h: Voyager 1 team, unbowed by communications glitch, celebrates epic 1-light-day distance milestone
stories.t: The Voyager 1 team celebrated the probe's big distance milestone on Thursday (Nov. 19), even while dealing with a communication anomaly that recently cropped up on the probe.

'PAC-MAN' capsules that gobble up particles in turbulent water show promise for filtration and drug delivery
stories.t: Scientists have created hollow capsules with single openings that can selectively filter particles thanks to the turbulence in surrounding waters—at times, ingesting particles like PAC-MAN eating up dots.

stories.h: Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent
stories.t: Apple is working on its own AI agent that can perform a range of tasks for you, including browsing the web, working across apps, writing code, and calling services.

stories.h: Xi-Putin-Trump summit was heavy on symbolism, light on substance – and not exactly a Yalta II
stories.t: At an eagerly anticipated summit, the leaders of China, Russia and US discussed nuclear weapons – but not much else.
